sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: Each example contains the correction, not just the answer.

items.prompt: A model predicts a $80 rate will increase by 25%. What is the new rate?

steps: Identify what the problem is asking and which quantities, assumptions, or constraints matter.
Build and solve a model, then check the result against the context.

items.prompt: A storage container is 4 by 3 by 2 feet. What is its volume in cubic feet?

steps: Identify what the problem is asking and which quantities, assumptions, or constraints matter.
Build and solve a model, then check the result against the context.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Before solving, say which error the problem is testing for.

items.prompt: A data set has the values 15, 30, 45, 60, 75. The mean is 45. What is the mean absolute deviation (MAD), a measure of the data's uncertainty or spread?
A student claims a box that is 4 by 2 by 6 units has a volume of 50 cubic units. Evaluate the claim.
choices: Yes; the volume is 50 cubic units.
No; the volume is 52 cubic units, not 50.
No; the volume is 48 cubic units, not 50.
No; the volume is 51 cubic units, not 50.

items.prompt: A rental company charges a $16 base fee plus $2 per hour. A customer's total bill was $28. Which equation models this situation, and how many hours were rented?

A diver starts at the surface (0 m) and descends 19 m, then descends another 22 m, then ascends 27 m. The dive plan assumes a depth limit of 59 m below the surface. What is the diver's final position, as a signed number of meters?

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A model predicts a $760 rate will decrease by 5%. What does the model predict as the new rate?
A storage container is designed as a rectangular prism 6 ft long, 8 ft wide, and 7 ft high. What is its volume in cubic feet?
A data set has the values 51, 56, 61, 66, 71. The mean is 61. What is the mean absolute deviation (MAD), a measure of the data's uncertainty or spread?
A student claims a box that is 4 by 8 by 8 units has a volume of 258 cubic units. Evaluate the claim.
choices: Cannot be determined from the given information.
Yes; the volume is 258 cubic units.
No; the volume is 256 cubic units, not 258.
No; the volume is 259 cubic units, not 258.
